./docs/evaluation.md:23:Each non-dry run starts a separate ephemeral `codex exec --json` session with `--ignore-user-config`. The current Codex CLI still discovers Skills in the project; this switch bypasses the malformed user config and does not remove skill discovery. Every run saves stdout/stderr evidence and appends a result. Inspect and redact traces before publishing them; the scenarios are public and synthetic, but model output may include environment context. Failed CLI requests are `BLOCKED`; successful model responses are `NEEDS_REVIEW`. The runner never grants PASS automatically.
./docs/agent-usage-guide.md:50:| Claude Code | Run `python3 scripts/install-skills.py --target .claude/skills`; start a new session or refresh skills, then inspect `/skills`. |

Prompt-input discovery is not automatic activation evidence. Only mark activation PASS when the Codex session trace proves automatic invocation for the positive case and no unintended invocation for the negative case. Current environment limitations are in [operational readiness](../operational-readiness.md).
./docs/platforms/claude.md:3:Install project-level copies into `.claude/skills/` with the installer. Keep the directory name equal to the frontmatter `name`. Start a new session or refresh skills, then use `/skills` to inspect availability. Claude Code may invoke a Skill when relevant; you can also call it directly as a slash command, for example `/ui-ux-review`. Direct invocation is not an automatic-activation evaluation. See the [AI agent usage guide](../agent-usage-guide.md) for task scoping and evidence labels.
./docs/operational-readiness.md:17:The web fixture was exercised in Codex's in-app browser. It now has product-specific accessible names for repeated add-to-cart actions, a section link whose wording matches its newsletter destination, and visibly distinct pending/error/success form states. The behavior was checked at 390×844; representative layouts were visually inspected at 390×844, 768×1024, and 1280×900. The mobile menu opened, closed with Escape, and returned focus to its trigger. Invalid email focused the field and exposed the error through the associated live status; a synthetic `.fail` submission kept its value and showed a retry message; a valid submission announced success. Error text/background contrast is 7.45:1 and success contrast is 6.87:1, computed from the fixture's CSS colors. These checks support the targeted states only; no real newsletter service, user study, screen reader, TalkBack, Android build, other orientation, or full WCAG conformance was tested. CUA screenshots were visible during the session but the interface did not provide a local export path, so screenshot pixels are not committed. This manual fixture run is not attributed to automatic Skill activation. See the [fixture verification record](fixture-ux-validation.md), [before evidence](../evals/evidence/web-fixture-before.md), and [after evidence](../evals/evidence/web-fixture-after.md).
